title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
summary: The company's move to bring Huang back marks a sharp reversal from its board's decision just days earlier to rule out his return

blocks.text: JENSEN HUANG. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang arrives for a meeting with SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won at SK group’s office building in Seoul, South Korea, June 8, 2026.
The company's move to bring Huang back marks a sharp reversal from its board's decision just days earlier to rule out his return
Nvidia on Monday, November 23, said it is reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive, effective immediately.
Nvidia shares surged on the news, jumping more than 25% in premarket trading.
The company’s move to bring Huang back marks a sharp reversal from its board’s decision just days earlier to rule out his return.

Huang built Nvidia from a video-game chip designer into the dominant supplier of AI processors, steering its chip roadmap, customer deals and Washington ties along the way. (TIMELINE: Jensen Huang’s fall from Nvidia grace)
He resigned on November 12 after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman US authorities suspect of spying for China, an allegation Beijing denies.
The board said it was satisfied with Huang’s candor and leadership ability and, after receiving input from senior US government officials, saw no national security risk in his return. – Rappler.com
